title: DeepCC: a deep learning-based framework for cancer classification
text: DeepCC ships bundled MSigDB snapshot (release 2026.1.Hs, 35,361 gene sets) functional spectra work offline without optional dependency. pull newest release instead, install msigdbr: Pinning geneSets explicit release keeps analysis reproducible even MSigDB updated.
code: library(DeepCC)  # eps: data.frame or matrix (samples × genes), colnames are Entrez IDs fs <- getFunctionalSpectra(eps) # Bundled snapshot (default, offline) fs <- getFunctionalSpectra(eps) fs <- getFunctionalSpectra(eps, geneSets = "MSigDB_2026.1.Hs")  # Newest release from msigdbr, optionally filtered to one collection MSigDBr <- get_msigdbr() fs <- getFunctionalSpectra(eps, geneSets = MSigDBr)  hallmark <- get_msigdbr(collection = "H") fs <- getFunctionalSpectra(eps, geneSets = hallmark)
